column1: Another admin saved the settings while I was editing in the admin portal. What happens to my changes?
column3: Overwrite with mine|Discard mine and load theirs
column4: Revision-check conflict handling keeps untouched fields from other version, offers two save options

column1: Why does the unique users count in analytics go up when one person uses agents in two teams?
column4: Unique users counted with pseudonymous IDs per team, so counted twice

column1: What is the shortest retention period I can set for the audit log?
column4: Audit log retention period must be at least 30 days

column1: How long can a platform admin's break-glass session last by default, and what is the maximum?
column4: Longest session default is 8 hours, range 15 minutes to 24 hours

column1: How detailed does the reason have to be when I start a break-glass session to read a team's conversations?
column4: Break-glass reason minimum length is 20 characters, visible to owners

column1: Why am I refused when I try to lower a team's approved classification level?
column4: Lowering refused while team has sources or attached shared sources above new level

column1: What characters and length are allowed for an agent's short name in the admin portal?
column4: Short names are unique, 2-40 chars of lowercase letters, digits, hyphens

column1: Why can't any web source crawl on my brand-new install, and how can I preload allowed domains?
column4: New install allowlist is empty; CRAWL_ALLOWLIST_SEED adds patterns once on first start

column1: What error do chats get when a team uses up its monthly budget in Enforce mode?
column4: At 100% under Enforce, chats and searches refused with 429 budget_exhausted

column1: A team ran out of budget and I want to let it keep working this month only. What are my options?
column4: Grant extension adds an amount for this month only, lapsing at month end

column1: After I switch a knowledge base to a new embedding profile, how long can I still switch back?
column4: Old vectors kept 7 days by default, configurable 0-90 per migration

column1: Which vector storage type should I pick for an embedding model with more than 2,000 dimensions?
column4: halfvec indexes up to 4,000 dimensions; vector only up to 2,000

column1: If I turn off evaluations on the platform, do teams lose their evaluation sets and runs?
column4: Turning evaluations off hides tabs and keeps sets and runs

column1: What happens to signed-in users and anonymous public visitors when Valkey goes down?
column4: Signed-in traffic passes (fail-open); anonymous public traffic refused (fail-closed)

column1: What does an upload or crawl return while ingestion is paused, and what Retry-After does it send if no end time is set?
column4: Refused with 503 maintenance_mode; Retry-After is planned end or 5 minutes

column1: I refreshed an MCP server's tools and one of them is no longer approved. Why?
column4: Tool with changed title, description or input schema loses approval on re-read

column1: What timeout can I set for calls to a registered MCP server, and what is the default?
column4: MCP server timeout ranges 1-120 seconds, default 30

column1: How often does Grounded automatically re-test my model gateway connections in the background?
column4: Worker re-tests enabled connections every 15 minutes at no cost

column1: What is the size limit for the extra request fields JSON I can add to a chat model's compatibility settings?
column4: Extra request fields JSON object is at most 4,096 bytes

column1: Why do our public agent pages, widgets and public API refuse everything after a fresh install?
column4: Allow public agents is off on a new install

column1: When streaming checked paragraphs, how does Grounded decide a long paragraph has ended so it can be moderated?
column4: Long paragraph is released at last sentence end after about 800 characters

column1: How many pages per day can a team OCR before documents start waiting?
column4: Default team OCR limit is 1,000 pages per UTC day

column1: I turned OCR on but my scanned pages are still being skipped. What should I check?
column4: Causes of skipped scans: source OCR switch, zero daily limit, vision model

column1: Can I change a team's slug after creating the team?
column4: Team slug is used in addresses and cannot be changed later

column1: How can I send people without a team to our own service desk form instead of a platform admin?
column4: TEAM_REQUEST_URL links to your own team request form

column1: What range can I set for how long a search waits for the reranker, and what happens when it is slower?
column4: Reranker time limit range; slow call keeps usual order

column1: My reranker server is Hugging Face text embeddings inference and rejects the request. What do I change?
column4: Set rerank model's Passages field to texts for TEI servers

column1: How long are evaluation runs and their results kept before they are deleted?
column4: Evaluation runs and results default retention is 180 days

column1: If I place a legal hold on a team, are its document passages and vectors preserved?
column4: Holds keep documents' stored files, not passages and vectors

column1: If I set the platform currency to EUR, are existing prices converted?
column4: Currency is a display code only; no conversion happens

column1: Why were members removed from their teams after our identity provider stopped sending groups?
column4: Missing groups claim counts as no groups and removes managed members

column1: What is the default time limit an answer waits for SystemOne passage judging?
column4: Passage judging time limit default is 1.5 seconds

column1: How do I know why my admin PUT request is rejected with a 428?
column4: Admin writes need If-Match revision; missing gives 428

column1: Why isn't the /mcp endpoint in the OpenAPI reference?
column4: MCP server is JSON-RPC, so absent from OpenAPI document

column1: What is the default rate limit per API key?
column4: Per-key rate limit default is 300 queries per minute

column1: My script runs in a signed-in browser and writes fail. What header do I need to add?
column4: Browser session writes need CSRF token header from GET /v1/me

column1: Why does my chat stream emit text_reset and what do I do with it?
column4: text_reset discards answer text so far, e.g. after a tool call

column1: How do I turn off reranking on a knowledge base search to compare with the usual order?
column4: Send rerank: false to compare without reranking

column1: How many follow-up suggestions can an agent send after an answer, and how long can they be?
column4: Suggestions: 1 to 3 questions, max 150 characters each

column1: Why is the system prompt I send to /v1/chat/completions ignored?
column4: Client system messages are dropped; agent instructions win

column1: In the claims array, how should I count a claim whose verdict is uncited?
column4: Uncited claims count as not supported

column1: How many knowledge bases can I attach to one agent?
column4: An agent can use up to five knowledge bases

column1: What keyboard shortcut opens the command palette in the web app?
column4: Command palette opens with Cmd/Ctrl+K

column1: How do I start the Docker demo on a different port because 8080 is taken?
column4: Set GROUNDED_DEMO_PORT to change demo port

column1: Can I downgrade Grounded to an earlier version after an upgrade?
column4: Upgrades are forward-only; downgrading means restoring a backup

column1: How do I start a Postgres backup right now instead of waiting for the nightly one?
column4: Manual backup via kubectl create job from the backup CronJob

column1: Why do I need to suspend the backup CronJobs before restoring the database?
column4: Suspending prevents an empty database becoming the newest dump

column1: Can I load the SMTP password from a mounted file instead of an environment variable?
column4: Secrets can be read from files by appending _FILE to the name

column1: How many pages of a scanned document will OCR read before skipping the rest?
column4: OCR page limit per document defaults to 200

column1: Why does a model show as healthy in the admin portal when its upstream is actually out of GPU memory?
column4: Scheduled checks only verify the model is listed, not working

column1: How long are stored health check results kept before they are pruned?
column4: health_checks keeps 7 days plus each subject's latest check

column1: My Grounded pod is stuck in ErrImagePull with a strange placeholder tag. What did I forget?
column4: Overlay must set images: to pin a digest, else placeholder tag fails

column1: I changed a value in the grounded-runtime secret but the pods still use the old one. How do I apply it?
column4: Secrets aren't hashed, so pods need a manual rollout restart

column1: How long do MCP OAuth access tokens and refresh tokens last?
column4: Access token 1 hour; refresh token 30 days, renewed on use

column1: Why does /mcp return 404 for every client, and how do I turn it on?
column4: MCP server is off by default; admin switch enables it

column1: How do I stop Qwen3 models on vLLM or SGLang from spending time thinking before answering?
column4: Set chat_template_kwargs enable_thinking false via the model setting

column1: What does the /readyz endpoint check and what does it return when something is down?
column4: Readiness checks Postgres, Valkey, storage within 2 s; else 503

column1: Why does the OCR Test button say "No text came back" after I switched to Apache Tika?
column4: Tika needs its -full image with Tesseract to return OCR text

column1: Sign-in is refused because my email isn't verified. How can I allow it?
column4: Disable verified-email requirement if the provider's emails are trusted

column1: What minimum PostgreSQL and pgvector versions does an install need?
column4: PostgreSQL 17 with pgvector 0.8 or later

column1: What are the steps to rotate ENCRYPTION_KEY without losing stored gateway credentials?
column4: Keep old key as ENCRYPTION_KEY_PREVIOUS, then run rotate-keys

column1: Does a warning make grounded doctor fail, and what exit code signals a failed check?
column4: doctor exits 1 on a failed check; warnings don't fail it

column1: Why are my public agent requests ignoring the traceparent header I send?
column4: Public routes ignore incoming trace context to resist anonymous callers

column1: Can I roll back to the previous release after an upgrade if something breaks?
column4: Roll back by pinning previous digest; migrations never roll back

column1: I build a custom OCR image with extra Tesseract language packages. What changed in the v0.4.4 upgrade?
column4: OCR image base moved to Debian 13; recheck tesseract package names

column1: I hit Stop in the middle of a chat answer. What do I get, and is the partial answer kept?
column4: Stopping keeps the partial answer and shows a stopped notice with Ask again

column1: Why does a citation show a claim as only 'not supported' instead of red 'contradicted'?
column4: Contradiction is shown only at or above the auto-accept threshold, 80% default

column1: I clicked thumbs down on an answer by mistake. Can I undo it?
column4: Since v0.4.2 a rating can be removed via the thumbs-down menu

column1: How many knowledge bases can one agent search, and how many passages per search can I override it to?
column4: Agents take up to five KBs; per-agent passage override is 1 to 20

column1: What does the agent say by default when its sources have no answer to a question?
column4: Default refusal message text under strict grounding

column1: Why are the welcome message and starter questions read-only for me as an editor on a live agent?
column4: Live agent profile fields changeable only by admins and owners since v0.4.2

column1: I crawled a website but some pages were indexed with no content. Why?
column4: Crawler does not run JavaScript so browser-rendered pages come back empty

column1: When do automatic evaluation runs happen, and are they full-answer runs?
column4: Nightly 03:00 UTC, after publish, after migration; retrieval only

column1: What is the difference between recall@k and MRR in a retrieval evaluation run?
column4: Score is recall@k share passed; MRR measures how high first expected doc ranks

column1: Why is a topic of unanswered questions not appearing on the Gaps page yet?
column4: Topic shows only once 3 different people asked about it

column1: What is the difference between 'Dismiss for now' and 'Not for this agent' on a gap topic?
column3: Dismiss for now|Not for this agent
column4: Dismiss for now reopens on new failures; Not for this agent stays closed

column1: What is the default vector and keyword weight for a knowledge base search, and when should I raise keyword weight?
column4: Platform default vector 1, keyword 0.1; higher keyword for codes and names

column1: Why did a follow-up question in a conversation never get a saved answer?
column4: Only the first question of a conversation can reuse a saved answer

column1: Can I put a single * as the allowed origin for my widget key so any site can embed it?
column4: A lone * origin is refused; list sites or wildcard under own domain

column1: How do I call one of my agents from an OpenAI-compatible client, and what is the model name format?
column4: Agents are models named agent:<team>/<agent> on the chat completions API

column1: My analytics show a low claims-supported figure but a high cited-sources-support figure. What does that mean?
column4: Low claims with high per-source figure usually means uncited sentences

column1: Why is the Publish button greyed out in my agent editor?
column4: Publish is disabled while draft has problems listed under Build

column1: I reverted my agent to an older version but people still get the current answers. Why?
column4: Reverting changes only the draft; must publish to go live

column1: How do I stop an agent from showing suggested next questions under its answers?
column4: Build, Advanced toggle Suggest follow-up questions turns chips off

column1: Why do some answers in the chat have no follow-up question chips at all?
column4: Chips only follow answers that cite sources and finish normally

column1: Follow-up suggestions never show up with our reasoning chat model. What should the operator set?
column4: Reasoning models need How to turn thinking off or hit time limit

column1: My AI tool gets a 403 when connecting to the Grounded MCP address. What does that mean?
column4: 403 from MCP endpoint means key lacks MCP scope

column1: Can I ask follow-up questions through MCP when I connect with a team service key?
column4: Conversation follow-ups over MCP ask require a personal key

column1: My desktop assistant can only launch local stdio servers. Can it connect to Grounded over MCP?
column4: Only Streamable HTTP supported; stdio clients need a bridge

column1: What happens to a personal API key when its owner leaves the team, and to a service key?
column4: Personal keys revoked on leaving; service keys keep working

column1: How long does Grounded keep audit log entries?
column4: Retention set by platform, minimum 30 days; legal hold never deleted

column1: Why can't I change the role of someone who shows Managed by SSO group?
column4: SSO-managed members' roles can't be changed by hand

column1: What is the default daily chat token limit for a team?
column4: Default chat tokens per day for a team is 2,000,000

column1: What stops working when our team's enforced monthly budget hits 100%?
column4: At 100% enforced budget, chats and searches refused

column1: How do I turn on dark mode, and does it follow me to other browsers?
column4: Theme set via account menu or Ctrl+K, stored per browser

column1: Why do I see an Open full document button on a source but my colleague doesn't?
column4: Full document access limited to editors, admins and owners
